modifiers.meaning: While inside smoke/steam reduce footsteps audible range20%; does not see through occluders.
Electrified surface damage received reduced25%; direct lightning damage unchanged.
Owner sees already-explored static river/soil/flame sockets in surface preview; reveals no dynamic hidden fields or actors.
Electrified surface damage received reduced25%; strongest with storm_resistance, never multiplicative.
Wet residual duration after leaving water/rain reduced from3000 to1500ms; does not prevent Wet in water or frost stun.
Own newly placed nonobjective wards/traps/conduits/anchors HP +15%; snapshot at creation, emitter HP bonus cap20% total.
Frost surface lifetime+1000ms, within10000ms cap; no unit stun/slow boost.
Melee basic hit adds12 physical damage if victim has no other ordinary body within300cm; once4000ms per owner. Server evaluates; no hidden-neighbor feedback.
Frost field disk radius or line half-width +10%, footprint remains16cells. No range or stun bonus.
Basic attack against Wet victim adds15 magical damage, once4000ms per owner; does not electrify map, jump or stun.
Successful basic attack applies Burning for3000ms, once5000ms per owner; no surface creation. Water can extinguish.
Basic attack damage from front120-degree arc reduced8% within ordinary60% physical mitigation cap. No hard-control block.
Own placed wards/conduits last+2000ms within their documented lifetime cap; no new repair/active action.
Frozen-surface slow magnitude reduced from30% to15%; no Wet-stun immunity.
Burning unit-status damage received reduced25%; direct Fire damage and burning-surface damage unchanged.
Self and aid-consenting recipients within300cm/geometry gain4 armor. Multiple banners strongest only; membership revoked immediately; no stat gate access.
Own newly created Steam/Electrified fields +1000ms within their caps; never buffs Wet stun or creates extra reactions.
After2000ms stationary in authored cover, gain concealment until moving/releasing action/damage/cover exit. Detector reveals; not active invisibility.
